notes.title: 1.8.20 - Balance patch
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. Today, it is a balance patch aimed at making the game more understandable and accessible for newcomers.

The mana cost required to move a piece is now fixed and no longer depends on water:
[list]
[*]Pawns and knights: require 1 mana
[*]Rooks and bishops: require 2 mana
[*]Queens and kings: require 3 mana
[/list]
This change is noticeable in the mid-game and late-game. It's an explicit buff for pawns, rooks, bishops and knights, and a deliberate nerf for the king, which was much needed.

Certain ascensions have been adjusted in line with this change and now have the advantage of no longer varying based on whether it's a player piece or an AI piece:
[list]
[*]Water ascension: now provides 1 extra mana max
[*]Lightning ascension: now provides 1 extra mana income 
[*]Ice ascension: the frozen piece receives 25% more damage (I'm not certain about this one, perhaps 50% is preferable, but I don't have enough feedback on this ascent yet)
[/list]
Certain spells and items have also had to be modified or rebalanced:
[list]
[*]Wings
[*]Superconductivity (unfortunately, still a rather bad spell in my opinion)
[*]Burning Bypass
[*]Toxic Bypass
[*]Blessed Bypass
[*]Explosive Bypass
[*]Fire aura (nice update on this one)
[*]Toxic aura
[*]Frozen aura 

[*]Magic broom
[*]Starving fish is removed and replaced by the "Papper plane"
[/list]
Since water no longer has downside, water spells now provide less.

This is just the beginning of several balancing updates. I didn't pay much attention to it when I revisited the spells, the goal being to find enjoyment in them above all. It was only the first step.

Enjoy!

[/list]
[h3]Conclave[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
[h3]Harakiri[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] This spell has two major issues: it only works if we can apply curse, and it kills a piece. To solve these, it now applies a curse, and the effects of the pieces have been significantly enhanced. The spell costs more, and I believe it's perfectly usable in all situations.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: 1.8.7 - Ice spells updated
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As I suspected, the Frost School was easy. There are 2 spells that have significant changes, and I took the opportunity to rework some that were bothering me.

[h2]My feedbacks[/h2]
[list]
[*] I didn't feel the change in mana cost for moving the pieces.
[*] Being able to accumulate charges of electric ascension and water ascension is so cool. We can really enhance the quality of our spells during a game, and it's exhilarating.
[*] The bypass spells still have an issue; they are weak.
[/list]

[h2]Spells[/h2]

[h3]Ice breaker (now Ice of Damocles)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] A spell that can only be used on frozen targets is too restrictive. Since the ice school didn't have a control spell, I modified it to be unique in its usage: it will burst on frozen targets but act as an immobilization spell otherwise.
[/list]

[h3]Song of the Archdeacon[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] I hesitated to remove it, but I'm not objective. I love the spell. The problem is that chance makes the spell uninteresting. So, I ensured that the Archdeacon spawns after a certain time, and I improved the effects on pieces in such a way that it can become a "core-spell."
[/list]

Subconsciously (or not), I've been using categories for the spells based on their cost. Spells that cost "2 energy / 6 mana" are too few to form a category on their own. So, I reworked them to fit into the "1 energy / 7 mana" spells category. In the process, I adjusted them accordingly.
[list]
[*] Tsunami: actually, I went back and reverted the changes for this one.
[*] Thunder strike: I found something really cool, I'm very happy with the change.
[*] Ice wave: I think I found the missing piece to make this spell appealing.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rotten mushroom
[*] Rubix
[*] Golden fortress: catapult targeting
[/list]

Enjoy!

[/list]
[h3]Pact of Odmund[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
Spells with propagation are particularly challenging to use, especially on small chessboards. I'll provide some tools to make it easier for you to use them.

[h3]Aura of celerity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Medium
[*] The concept of this spell is excellent, but the bonus effects don't do justice to such a costly spell. Therefore, I have expanded the basic idea with additional elements to give it better viability.
[/list]
[h3]Attractive vortex (now repulsive vortex)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] This spell was too complicated to use, ineffective, and redundant with the blitz swap. I have drastically modified it to create a powerful repulsion effect, giving it a unique identity among control spells.
[/list]
[h3]Blitz swap[/h3]
[list]
[*] Medium
[*] This version of the spell is more flexible.
[/list]
[h3]Charged bolts[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] The spell is fun, but its flexibility is poor. I have adjusted it to make it interesting in all circumstances, and with some success!
[/list]
[h3]Lightning bolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Medium
[*] By combining the ideas of the fire wave, poisoned stinger, and the new charged bots, this spell (which was already great) is now even better.
[/list]
[h3]Spuerconductivity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] Queen effect added to improve placement.
[*] Like the lightning nova, this spell is underestimated.
[/list]
[h3]Thunder of Odmund[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] I followed the same procedure as with the charged bolts, which makes it easier to use.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*] Odmund now starts with the burning Bypass instead of the water elemental, and blitz swap instead of attractive vortex. I'm still not entirely sure about this starting set. I would really love for the class to be able to play lightning tiles, but I haven't found a suitable spammable spell for that. It's possible that it may change again.
[*] Fixed the lightning ascension on AI. It now generates 2 mana (it no longer depends on the amount of water).
[*] From now on, pieces with 100 water only cost 3 mana to move. This change is made on a whim. As I write this sentence, I have not yet tested its impact (positive or negative) on the game. But I feel that the late game is becoming too challenging due to the astronomical cost of moving pieces. Alea iacta est.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.8.4 - Earth spells
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today, it's the turn of earth spells. Since I have ChatGPT at hand, I'll take the opportunity to delve a little deeper into my thoughts. So, it's a bit of an update and a bit of a diary.

Earth spells are really cool. There aren't many major changes. However, I did find some nice little things.

[h2]Spells[/h2]

[h3]Castling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major
[*] This spell was either too powerful if you had the right spell or useless and never chosen. Its usage has become much more versatile: it allows the king to easily cast powerful spells and effectively sustain their life. However, its mana cost has been doubled.
[/list]
[h3]Catapult[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] I just slightly changed the effect of the queen.
[/list]
[h3]Double saw[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] This spell is good, the pawn and the queen help to play with different schools.
[/list]
[h3]Earth breaker[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] It's strangely complicated to put earth on the pieces. I'm terrified at the thought of earth ascension being too easily accessible. Since it's not a spell that we spam, I added the effect of the pawn that allows you to gain a large heap of earth.
[/list]
[h3]Earthquake[/h3]
[list]
[*] Medium
[*] The spell itself is not bad, but it was too expensive to use. I preferred to reduce the damage and its mana cost. The effects are now more in line with the spell.
[/list]
[h3]Fortification[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] In line with the spell's concept, it can also protect against harmful elements.
[/list]
[h3]Rock[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] The spell applies more earth. The idea is that the reward is greater if you use it to replenish your own pieces. It also allows you to place earth tiles.
[/list]
[h3]Root[/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor
[*] This spell is already challenging to use, but I know we haven't fully exploited its potential. However, I have still modified the effect of the knight to inflict damage instead of poison.
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]

The following spells have not been changed, as I find them to be good as they are:
[list]
[*] Barricade
[*] Earth gift
[*] Explosive Bypass
[/list]

For now, I won't make many changes to the summoning spells. I plan to come back to them later as I have a few ideas, but it involves the summoning aspect as a whole.

"Spikes" and "Swarm of leaves" remain unchanged as well. They are good as they are, but I had the idea of creating "passive" spells. There are several spells that can fit into this category, but that will be for later. First, I want to finish the magic schools, especially the lightning , which I find poorly designed.

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Geyser now spawn in an area
[*] Duplication: summoning sickness has been reduced from 10 to 1.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.8.0 - New tile system / Quantum rift up
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Since I recently started a job, updates are less frequent, but I am still working on the game. Honestly, I don't remember all the modifications, so here is a list of the general changes:

[list]
[*] All special tiles are available. They retain the same idea, so it won't be difficult to remember them. The goal is to enable the development of games for multiple schools of magic.
[*] The tiles have a global attack and can be boosted within a level.

[*] The quantum rift has its own bonus now.
[*] The items from the quantum rift are now stronger and no longer have upgrades (with the exception of the rift generator and quantum remote). Since playing as the quantum rift removes the possibility of a store, I have decided to make the forge less important for the quantum rift.
[*] 3 new items for the quantum rift.

[*]Many items have been reworked/updated with the new tile system.
[*]Items like 'applies 5 holy to a friendly piece' no longer target rocks.
[/list]

My overall feeling is that the new tile system is not yet fully operational. There are not enough means to flood the board with special tiles. The next update will focus on spells to enable this gameplay to exist. I will also take the opportunity to make some spells more attractive.

notes.title: Tiles are coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome for this first update of SideEffect.

[h1]Elements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fire: thresholds are now normalized on 25 (applies more damage in early game, less in late game).
[*]Poison: thresholds are now normalized on 25 (increases the frequency of poison explosion).
[*]Lightning ascension: when AI piece move, they generate mana for player(s) (once per turn).
[*]Fixed water removed when a player is casting a spell from an AI piece with water ascension.[/list]
Fire & poison are now closer to water and holy. This is easier to remember and I think about doing the same for ice & curse.

[h1]Tiles[/h1]

Here is the big one.

Today tiles are a support and I want them to become a viable strategy. This is what I did: most tiles now scale depending on the act you are, making them interesting in late game. For example, the fire tile applies 3 fire if you are playing act I, 4 if you are playing act II, and 5 if you are playing act III.

[h3]Fire tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Apply fire only when a player ends his turn.
[*]Scale depending on the act you are.
[*]New tile: Fire-Ice (applies fire + ice)
[*]Applying water on a tile does not remove Fire tiles anymore.
[*]Turn back from Fire-Holy and Fire-Curse to pure Fire removed.[/list]
[h3]Water tiles[/h3]
[list][*]Remove more fire when a player ends his turn.
[*]Scale depending on the act you are.
[*]New tile: Water-Fire (creates a conduction when a player ends his turn).
[*]Turn back from Water-Poison and Water-Holy to pure Water removed.[/list]
[h3]Air tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Air tiles are now removed when a piece uses the teleportation ability.
[*]New tiles: Air-Fire, Air-Water, Air-Earth, Air-Poison, Air-Lightning, Air-Ice, Air-Holy and Air-Curse (being on a Air-Fire allows the piece to teleports to any fire tiles and it is the same for others).[/list]
[h3]Earth tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Earth-Holy removed from the game: having a rock with 1HP or 5 HP is basically the same and this tile was a no-sense.
[*]New tile: Earth-Water (rocks start with 25 water).
[*]Turn back from Earth-Poison and Earth-Ice to pure Earth removed.[/list]
[h3]Poison tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now always stack 5 poison when a player ends his turn.
[*]Poison-Lightning: now applies 5 poison to the piece on it when a player ends his turn.
[*]Poison-Water: removed from the game and replaces by Poison-Air.
[*]Poison-Earth reworked: drains 5 poison from the piece when a player ends his turn and gives it to the tile[/list]
[h3]Lightning tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Scale depending on the act you are.
[*]New tile: Lightning-Holy (same behavior as others but with holy)[/list]
[h3]Holy tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]All holy tiles give 1 mana to players if there is a piece on it when a player ends his turn. [b]This value does not scale.[/b]
[*]Holy-Ice removed from the game (gameplay wasn't interesting).
[*]Holy-Lightning: damage scales depending on the act you are.
[*]Holy-Curse: attack bonus scales depending on the act you are.
[*]New tile: Holy-Water: gives energy to pieces (scales depending on the act you are.)[/list]
[h3]Curse tiles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Scale depending on the act you are.
[*]New tile: Curse-Water (applies water + curse).[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]

[h3]New items[/h3]
[list]
[*]Draconic insign (fire tiles related)
[*]Draconic amulet (fire tiles related)
[*]Bronze trophy (water tiles related)
[*]Silver trophy (water tiles related)
[*]Gold trophy (water tiles related)
[*]Pine cone (air tiles related)
[*]Bag of rocks (earth tiles related)
[*]Amulet of Solar (lightning tiles related)
[*]Ring of Dralphye (ice tiles related)
[*]Sacred idol (holy tiles related) 
[*]Quantum glitcher
[*]Quantum remote[/list]

[*]Rotten mushroom: reworked considering new poison tiles
[*]Insign of Tryff: has a new upgrade
[*]Acid flask: cost increased from 75 to 100 golds / cooldown increased from 8 to 10 turns
[*]Acid flask+: cost decreased from 100 to 50 golds / cooldown increased from 8 to 10 turns
[*]Chromatic dagger: can't heal friendly pieces anymore (damage only)

[*]Quantum attractor: now has an upgrade
[*]Cloack of vision: reworked (and there are more of them)[/list]

[*]Water explosion: pawn  effect added / knight reworked[/list]

Next update will be about 3 new bosses levels. Enjoy!
